question: Which of the following actions is **not allowed** for a player in handball?

options.text: Pulling or punching the ball out of an opponent's hands
Intercepting the ball mid-air using both hands
Dribbling the ball before making a pass
Blocking the ball with the torso above the knees

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pulling or punching the ball out of an opponent's hands**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In handball, players are prohibited from **pulling, punching, or forcibly removing the ball from an opponent's hands**, as it is considered a foul under the rules of the game.
 
• The sport emphasizes fair play and clean defense, where players must focus on intercepting the ball or blocking shots without aggressive physical contact.
 
• Using excessive force or unfair actions, such as punching the ball out of an opponent's hands, can lead to penalties, warnings, or even disqualification depending on the severity.
 
• The International Handball Federation (IHF) guidelines explicitly prohibit such actions to ensure the safety of players and maintain the integrity of the game.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Handball Rules:**

 
 
• Handball is a fast-paced team sport where two teams aim to score by throwing the ball into the opponent's goal.
 
• Players are required to follow strict rules that promote fair play and ensure the safety of all participants.
 
• Illegal moves, such as pulling or punching the ball from an opponent, are penalized to maintain the flow and spirit of the game.
